description: National Railway Network (NRWN) / Réseau ferroviaire national (RFN) is a dataset listed in Province of New Brunswick open data portal (gnb.socrata.com), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Province of New Brunswick. The National Railway Network (NRWN), version 1.0 focuses on providing a quality geometric description and a set of basic attributes of Canadian rail phenomena. / La version 1.0 du produit Réseau ferroviaire national vise à fournir une description géométrique de qualité et un ensemble de caractéristiques de base des phénomènes ferroviaires canadiens. Coverage: New Brunswick. Its tags are railway, national, ferroviaire, reseau, network. The table has 52 columns. Attribution on the portal: Service New Brunswick / Service Nouveau-Brunswick. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is New Brunswick Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-gnb-socrata-com-portal.
